citation: State of Haryana v. Ramesh Chand (2016) 6 SCC 234
reasoning_summary: Conviction under 304B dowry death upheld. Dying declaration recorded by magistrate was voluntary and truthful. Medical evidence showed unnatural burns. Prior dowry demands proven through parent testimony.

facts_established.actus_reus: Death by burns within 7 years of marriage
facts_established.mens_rea: Cruelty and harassment for dowry proven
